units.source_text: 石墙上的铁门都生锈了。

en.t: The iron gates in the stone wall were all rusted.

units.source_text: 常春藤的叶子像可怕的阴影似的爬满了一面墙。

en.t: Ivy leaves had crawled all over one wall like frightening shadows.

units.source_text: 忽然，看见玻璃窗的妻子紧紧抱住我，她全身颤抖。

en.t: Suddenly, my wife by the glass window clung tightly to me, her whole body trembling.
